premise: Nico wants to ride the biggest wave, but the first big one makes his knees wobble; Seal claps him on to start small, and he rides little wave after little wave.
inspiration: The boast-undone fable (the frog who would be as big as the ox), turned gentle: the boast becomes a plan, and the small steps are the brave part.

en-US.title: Nico's Big Wave
en-US.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} It was a perfect morning for surfing. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico came down the beach with his yellow board. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] "Today I'm riding the BIGGEST wave!" Out on the bay, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} the sailboat bobbed along, {sailboat:live} its sails puffing in the breeze. Then a wave rose up, tall and white and foamy. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico stopped. That wave was very big. {surfer:shake} His knees went wobbly. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal flopped up onto the rocks. {seal:face happy} {seal:live} She clapped her flippers. {sfx:bark} Arf, arf! {seal:hop} As if to say: start small. So Nico waited for a little wave. {surfer:go to sea by surf} Swoosh! He was up! {turtle:enter by swim} Turtle swam alongside, {turtle:hearts} smiling. Nico rode the little wave {surfer:go to sand by surf} all the way back to the sand. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:hop x2} Then another. And another. {surfer:live} Nico waved to Seal and held up his board. {surfer:says} [happily] "Thanks, Seal! The big one can wait till tomorrow." {seal:hearts}

es-ES.title: La gran ola de Nico
es-ES.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} Era una mañana perfecta para hacer surf. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico bajó por la playa con su tabla amarilla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] «¡Hoy voy a coger la ola MÁS GRANDE!» En la bahía, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} el velero se mecía, {sailboat:live} con las velas hinchadas por la brisa. Entonces se levantó una ola alta, blanca y llena de espuma. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico se paró. Aquella ola era muy grande. {surfer:shake} Le temblaban las rodillas. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca subió a las rocas dando saltitos. {seal:face happy} {seal:live} Dio palmadas con las aletas. {sfx:bark} ¡Arf, arf! {seal:hop} Como diciendo: empieza por las pequeñas. Así que Nico esperó una ola pequeñita. {surfer:go to sea by surf} ¡Zas! ¡Ya estaba de pie! {turtle:enter by swim} Tortuga nadaba a su lado, {turtle:hearts} sonriendo. Nico se dejó llevar por la ola {surfer:go to sand by surf} hasta la arena. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:hop x2} Luego otra. Y otra más. {surfer:live} Nico saludó a Foca con la tabla en alto. {surfer:says} [happily] «¡Gracias, Foca! La grande puede esperar a mañana.» {seal:hearts}
